text_block_list.text: When I was out off-campus, I spotted Jungle Pocket and Air Messiah street dancing.
choice_data_list: Pocket? Why are you dancing here...?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer! You asking why?
Because the academy's studio was totally booked.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I was the one having trouble finding an open spot.
Then Pocket-senpai brought me over here...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I used to dance here with my crew all the time.
We'd blast hype tracks and just do our own thing.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: All right, Messiah, let's resume the lesson!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Try riding the wave of the rhythm more.
Like, whooosh~! You know?"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Ride the wave of the rhythm...
Is it... like this?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in a Beanie
text_block_list.text:
Waaaay!
Today's the day we master that step!
...Wait, who're they? Ain't seen those faces before, have we?

text_block_list.name: Hoodie Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Those tracksuits—they're from Tracen Academy.
No wonder their dancing is so well-behaved.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...... Pocket-senpai,
I believe it would be wise to change locations.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, hold up.
That one was pretty awkward too, y'know?
Let me show you how it's done.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in a Beanie
text_block_list.text:
What? Now she's the one dancing?
I mean, it's not like her steps are gonna be anything special—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in a Beanie
text_block_list.text: !? What in the world was that move...!?

text_block_list.name: Hoodie Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
What an incredible groove!
Is this the power of a Tracen Academy Umamusume...!?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...What a fun-looking dance...
I see, so this is what they call 'groove'...!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Don't sweat it if you mess up.
Just step however you like and give it a try.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Because before you know it, you'll catch the rhythm and dance until you drop!
choice_data_list: Your body just starts moving on its own, huh
Your body just starts moving on its own, doesn't it
What a free dance, unbound by common sense...!
It's such a free dance, unbound by common sense, isn't it...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Because before you know it, you'll catch the rhythm and dance until you drop!
choice_data_list: Your body just starts moving on its own, huh
Your body just starts moving on its own, doesn't it
What a free dance, unbound by common sense...!
It's such a free dance, unbound by common sense, isn't it...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Going wild just the way you want,
that's what dancing is all about!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in a Beanie
text_block_list.text:
"Hell yeah, you're the best!
It's no fun without some real passion, after all!"

text_block_list.name: Hoodie Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I like you! Let's dance together!
How about your friend over there, too?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Me, as well...?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Follow our lead, Messiah!
Just empty your mind and run!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Y-Yes.
Is it like this...?"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Haha, hell yeah!
Let's all just dance our hearts out!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
You're exaggerating.
I was just dancing however I felt like.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...Pocket-senpai. Could you teach me the secret
to feeling the groove?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"I want to try dancing in a way that breaks out
of my current shell.
...Just like Pocket-senpai."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sure thing. Then tell me
what part of my dance just now you liked.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"That's the groove you love, after all.
Let's find your dance together!"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Pocket-senpai... Yes.
I look forward to working with you.
